_comentario: MODELO TEENS. Aula 12 = 12o ENCONTRO e CHECKPOINT 1 em formato CONVERSA (feedback da professora Barbara em 01/10/2026 + analise das 11 aulas gravadas): sem viagem, sem persona adulta, sem reading longo; perguntas do mundo dela (escola, comida, futebol, arte), metade ela pergunta; Fix it com frases reais dela; visual juvenil (fundos claros, cards inclinados, fita adesiva, stickers) so nesta aula. Gramatica: revisao do present perfect atacando o erro real (had already, went como participio). Ruby agora e colega de escola da mesma idade. Vozes iguais as aulas 1-7.

listenings.text: Hi Sophia, it is Ruby. Okay, quick test week update. I have already done maths, and I think it went well, which is a miracle. I have done Portuguese too. I have not done history yet. It is on Thursday, and I have not even opened the book. Have you ever studied with music on? My mum says it does not work, but I have tried it all week and I think it helps. Oh, and I have just found the best acai place near school. They put condensed milk and sprinkles on top. You have to try it after the tests. Call me later!
